description: List the newest scheduled function runs (functions.crons) of an environment: one run per due UTC minute with state, attempt, the status the scheduled handler returned and timing. Use it to verify that a declared cron actually ran; deployment logs do not include scheduled runs.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: function_runs_list
